The schedule below satisfies all 14 constraints, so my earlier answer stands. The team note is wrong: Gus in slot 4 is impossible.

Checking each constraint against the schedule:
1. Elif (3) and Finn (1) have one person between them.
2. Ann (2) is immediately after Finn (1).
3. Cara (9) and Elif (3) are 6 apart.
4. Hana (5) and Ivo (8) are 3 apart.
5. Cara (9) and Hana (5) are 4 apart.
6. Ann (2) and Ben (4) have one person between them.
7. Gus (6) and Ivo (8) have one person between them.
8. Elif (3) and Gus (6) are 3 apart.
9. Finn (1) is before Cara (9).
10. Ben (4) and Gus (6) have one person between them.
11. Elif (3) is before Gus (6).
12. Ben (4) is before Dev (7).
13. Finn (1) is before Gus (6).
14. Ivo (8) is immediately after Dev (7).

The note fails because if Gus is in slot 4, Ben must be in slot 2 or 6. Either way Ann must be in slot 4 or 8 (two from Ben), and slot 4 is taken by Gus, so Ann is in slot 8. That puts Finn in slot 7, which violates "Finn is before Gus," since Gus is in slot 4. So no valid schedule has Gus in slot 4.

CONFIDENCE: 97
